notes: New: Field Barriers. A rare map tile that blocks the way unless your active partner's type matches (Fire, Water, Earth, Electric, Nature, Void, Metal or Glitch) — cross it with the right type fielded and it opens for good, paying Bits and a capture program. No Shop tool unlocks these; you need to have actually caught, and be fielding, that type.
A map can have several Field Barriers of different types, so fully looting one may mean swapping partners more than once.
